title: 全球半导体观察 — 青禾晶元完成最新一轮融资，资金将用于先进键合设备及键合衬底产线建设
notes: Archived 2026-10-07; article dated 2024-07-09 09:26:18 on its own page. Names the issuer at this date as 北京青禾晶元半导体科技有限责任公司 (Beijing-registered LLC, pre-Tianjin relocation); reports a funding round exceeding CNY 300m with investors 深创投, 远致星火, 芯朋微 plus existing holders 正为资本, 芯动能, 天创资本.

title: 半导体芯科技 (siscmag.com) — 青禾晶元集团迁址天津，开启发展新篇章
notes: Archived 2026-10-07; article dated 2025/1/10 11:26:08 and bylined 'iSABers青禾晶元' (the company's own name as author), republished by a trade magazine under its '集团资讯' channel. States the company relocated its head-office entity to Tianjin Binhai Hi-Tech Zone and formally renamed itself 青禾晶元半导体科技（集团）有限责任公司 — note this names a 有限责任公司 (LLC) form, whereas the company's own live site (isaber-s.com, archived 2026-10-07) currently gives its name with a 股份有限公司 (joint-stock) suffix; the two are not reconciled here and the discrepancy is carried in the entity notes.

title: 青禾晶元官网 (isabersgroup.com) — 【重磅发布】青禾晶元全球首发C2W&W2W双模混合键合设备，定义先进封装新标杆！
notes: Archived 2026-10-07 from the company's own official domain isabersgroup.com (新闻中心/集团资讯 channel; page's own contact email domain is isaber-s.com, same company), copyright footer '© 2024 青禾晶元半导体科技（集团）股份有限公司'. Reports a 2025-03-11 Hong Kong launch event for the SAB 82CWW series, a dual C2W/W2W-mode hybrid bonder, with named technical specifications and stated target applications (memory density/speed, Micro-LED, CMOS image sensors, photonic-electronic co-integration) — HBM is not named anywhere in this release.

title: 新浪财经 (转自证券时报·e公司) — 阳光电源投资半导体科技公司青禾晶元
notes: Archived 2026-10-07; article dated 2022-11-22 15:07, 转自：证券时报·e公司. States: 'e公司讯，企查查APP显示，近日，北京青禾晶元半导体科技有限责任公司发生工商变更，新增阳光电源(300274)等多名股东。青禾晶元成立于2020年，注册资本118.55万元，经营范围包含：制造6英寸及以上电子半导体材料(高污染、高环境风险的生产制造环节除外)；制造6英寸及以上化合物半导体集成电路圆片(高污染、高环境风险的生产制造环节除外)等。' This is a registry-change (企查查/Qichacha) report relayed by a financial wire, not a Sungrow-issued announcement; it gives no stake percentage or investment amount for Sungrow. Also the earliest-dated corroboration held for the company's 2020 establishment year and its original CNY 1,185,500 registered capital.

notes: Acquired 2026-10-08, local-first, because the W13 records review removed the platform alias SAB8210CWW as unsourced and the integrator then reported it to the user as a FABRICATION. That was wrong: the model is the page title and body text of the issuer's own product page on its own domain, which the atlas simply did not hold.
